text:
elena_cs: Flagging — MarTechCo showing a steep usage drop (approx -68% active seats last 12 days). Their champion (Tom R.) left last week. We noticed an RFP draft mentioning CompetitorY. Potential renewal risk.

kevin_csm: Yikes. when is their renewal window? any billing hiccups?

elena_cs: Renewal in 33 days. No billing alerts. CRM note: Tom removed as primary contact; new PM listed as Lina C but limited responses.

ryan_eng: any infra anomalies? errors or rate-limit changes? I can check logs quick.

elena_cs: No 5xx spikes. API call volume down, embed-heavy endpoints most affected.

ryan_eng: I'll run a quick query: ```sql
SELECT day, count(distinct user_id) AS active_users, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM events.usage
WHERE account='martechco'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 21;
```

maya_rev: looping in commercial. If procurement is soliciting CompetitorY, we should consider a focused commercial play (short-term credits or pilot pricing). Do we have committed tiers vs current consumption?

kevin_csm: not yet. elena can you confirm current seat counts and top integrators? also want to know if any exec-level engagement planned.

elena_cs: sending CRM update. top integrators: UI ingestion, batch embeddings job, and webhook processor. Lina auto-replied (PTO) to my DM.

renewals-bot: Reminder: renewal-30d alert for account martechco sent to @maya_rev and @kevin_csm.

kevin_csm: Proposed playbook: 1) Immediate 48-hr personalized outreach with small credit 2) Tech healthcall with Ryan 3) ROI + short pilot offer from Maya. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

elena_cs: +1. also suggest we offer Redwood Optimize quickscan (2-week) showing cost-savings from batching/quantization — could undercut CompetitorY noise.

ryan_eng: I can prep a healthcheck and token breakdown. need ~48h to pull traces and sample prompts.

maya_rev: I'll draft a pilot offer (3 months) and a one-pager comparing our latency/cost with a conservative competitor baseline. need the usage delta and top endpoints.

elena_cs: added asks to CRM: top-10 endpoints, seat churn last 30d, recent deploys.

kevin_csm: I'll schedule the outreach for tomorrow afternoon and take lead on account contact. elena, you manage the CRM updates. Ryan & Maya prep materials by EOD Wed.

elena_cs: on it. tagging MarTechCo as "at-risk - churn window" in CRM and assigning actions.

renewals-bot: Actions recorded: outreach scheduled, tech healthcall prep, ROI deck creation.

elena_cs: Update — Lina replied, available next Thu morning. She confirmed procurement is collecting vendor comparisons but is open to a short pilot if we can show cost wins and steady latency.

kevin_csm: Great. keep it tight. if they push pricing, Maya and I will respond. Ryan, prepare an example of quantization + batching that reduces token costs without noticeable quality drop.

ryan_eng: Will prepare a short demo and a recommended profile.

elena_cs: Thanks all. I'll post meeting notes after Thurs and escalate if procurement requests formal RFP pricing.

kevin_csm: Goal: convert to a constrained pilot rather than full RFP. :crossed_fingers:
